name: Natural Walnut Slat Tiles, Black Felt
summary: Walnut wood slat acoustic tiles in a dark walnut finish with a black felt backing.

texture.note: No manufacturer specifications were published: the dimension diagram gives a 12.60 × 47.24 in panel with 8 slats (1.575 in pitch); photo proportions suggest 1.125 in faces, 0.45 in straight felt gaps and lightly eased edges, while 0.83 in total thickness is an unverified estimate. This seamless tile is 8 pitches wide and 25.20 in tall, using walnut face tones sampled from the main listing photo and near-black felt; the installed pattern has no visible horizontal joint.
